conventions.claim_text: English paraphrase of each factual claim; figures kept in the source report's own units.
conventions.units: 億 USD = 100 million USD (so 698.7億 = 69.87B USD). 萬 = 10,000. Percentages and multiples as stated in the report.
conventions.shadow_check: Arithmetic recheck performed by this shadow from figures inside the reports only. ok = reproduces; minor_diff = differs only by rounding; not_checkable = no inputs in the reports; n/a = not a calculation.

status_legend.tool: Value returned by a pipeline tool (yf.py, ta.py). The reports state the tool data was cache-backed as of 2026-11-23.
status_legend.derived: Calculated by the report from tool fields.
status_legend.estimate: Analytical estimate or projection, labelled as such by the report.
status_legend.reported_web: From news, web search or secondary sources. Not verified against the primary source in the reports.
status_legend.conflicting: At least one other report or source gives a different value.
status_legend.unverified: The report itself says the item needs confirmation.
status_legend.stale: Outside the report's current window. Reference only.
status_legend.unavailable: The report states the data is missing. Recorded as a limitation.
status_legend.assessment: Judgment made by the reporting persona, not a factual claim.
